name: Odair Faléco
bio: AI director and writer of Sinuca de Bico (Cornered), a psychological drama short produced by zero1cine originals.
bioMore: Co-directed with Davi Moori and also voiced the film. Sinuca de Bico won Audience Choice and Best Narrative at the Cinema Shift Festival 2026 and Best Feature at BIFAN 2026, among other festival selections.
